BiblicalUsage: Abiathar was the priest who escaped Saul's slaughter at Nob and carried the ephod to David, staying loyal to him through flight and war. He served as priest beside Zadok, but in David's old age he backed Adonijah's claim to the throne, and Solomon removed him from the priesthood for it. His life runs from faithful service to a final, costly mistake.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Abiathar warns me that a long record of loyalty does not protect the last chapter. Finishing well matters as much as starting well, and I want to finish well.
RelatedPeople: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech; King David; Adonijah, Son of David
